### GUI Interface Description: LibreOffice Writer with Paragraph Settings Dialog

#### **1. Application Window**
- **Application Name**: LibreOffice Writer
- **Title Bar**: Displays the document name (`04 CHIN9505 EBook Purchasing Info 2021 Jan.docx`) and the application name (`LibreOffice Writer`).
- **Menu Bar**: Located at the top of the window, containing the following menus:
  - File
  - Edit
  - View
  - Insert
  - Format
  - Styles
  - Table
  - Form
  - Tools
  - Window
  - Help

#### **2. Toolbar**
- **Standard Toolbar**: Contains various icons for common actions such as:
  - Save
  - Undo/Redo
  - Clipboard actions (Cut, Copy, Paste)
  - Formatting options (Font, Font Size, Bold, Italic, Underline, etc.)
  - Alignment options (Left, Center, Right, Justify)
  - List options (Bulleted, Numbered)
  - Indentation and spacing controls
  - Highlighting and text color options
- **Formatting Toolbar**: Includes dropdowns for:
  - Paragraph styles (e.g., Normal (Web))
  - Font selection (e.g., Calibri)
  - Font size (e.g., 12 pt)

#### **3. Document Area**
- **Content**: Displays the text of the document. The visible text includes:
  - Instructions for using an eBook and subscription ID.
  - A support contact email (`service blcup.com`).
- **Page Layout**: Default Page Style is selected, and the language is set to English (USA).
- **Zoom Level**: Set to 173%, displayed in the bottom-right corner.

#### **4. Sidebar**
- **Icons**: A vertical bar on the left side of the screen with application shortcuts, including:
  - File Manager
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - Ubuntu Software
  - Help
  - Settings
  - Trash
  - GIMP

#### **5. Paragraph Settings Dialog**
- **Dialog Title**: Paragraph
- **Tabs**: Contains multiple tabs for paragraph customization:
  - **Outline & List** (active tab)
  - Indents & Spacing
  - Alignment
  - Text Flow
  - Tabs
  - Drop Caps
  - Borders
  - Area
  - Transparency
- **Outline & List Tab**:
  - **Outline Level**: Dropdown menu set to "Text Body."
  - **Apply List Style**:
    - Dropdown menu labeled "List Style" with "No List" selected.
    - Button labeled "Edit Style."
  - **Line Numbering**:
    - Checkbox labeled "Include this paragraph in line numbering" (checked).
    - Checkbox labeled "Restart at this paragraph."
    - Numeric input labeled "Start with" (value set to 1).
- **Buttons**:
  - Help
  - Reset
  - Cancel
  - OK

#### **6. Notifications**
- **Banner Messages**: Located below the toolbar, displaying:
  - "Help us make LibreOffice even better!"
  - "Your donations support our worldwide community."
- **Buttons**:
  - Get involved
  - Donate

#### **7. System Information**
- **Date and Time**: Displayed in the top-right corner as "Mar 22 05:00."
- **System Tray**: Includes icons for system notifications, network, and power settings.

#### **8. Tooltip**
- **Description**: A tooltip is visible over the "Outline & List" tab, stating: "Set outline level, list style, and line numbering for paragraph."
